name: AI Editoria11y
description: Adds a "Fix with AI" button to Editoria11y accessibility tooltips in CKEditor 5, using the AI CKEditor integration to suggest WCAG 2.1 AA fixes an editor reviews and applies.
project_description: AI Editoria11y bridges the Editoria11y accessibility checker and the drupal/ai CKEditor integration. When Editoria11y flags an issue in a CKEditor 5 field (missing table headers, empty or generic link text, skipped heading levels, fake lists, over-long alt text, and similar supported checks), the module injects a "Fix with AI" button into the Editoria11y tooltip. Clicking it opens the AI CKEditor dialog, sends the flagged element and its surrounding context to the configured AI provider through the ai_ckeditor request endpoint, streams back a suggested corrected HTML snippet, and shows a before/after diff. The editor reviews (and can edit) the suggestion before applying it in place; the fix is inserted through CKEditor's model so undo history is preserved, and Editoria11y re-checks the content. The module ships a single AiCKEditor plugin (FixAccessibility), a settings object holding customizable system/user prompts, a debug mode, and one permission that gates whether the integration library is attached.
